verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-session sync is a fair question for a collaborative work-tracking tool, but the evidence pack never documents live or instant propagation of teammates' changes without refreshing. Items like 'Stay up-to-date on the work's progress' describe views and automation, not real-time sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
